site.name: stratabox
site.summary: stratabox-clone Fictional headless content platform "Stratabox" marketing site (Contentful / Sanity-style). Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Single-page long scroll: sticky top nav; hero with editor-vs-live-preview split panel that periodically swaps blocks; trusted-by logo strip; 4-stat row with intersection-observer count-up; 3 feature cards; **live block builder** (drag-and-drop reorder, type switcher, add/delete blocks, two-pane editor + render with debounced auto-save status); 4-language SDK code tabs (JS / Python / Ruby / curl) with copy button; 24-card searchable integrations grid; 3 customer quotes; gradient pricing teaser; dark 4-column footer | | `styles.css` | Brand color #0E7E7E warm teal + cream paper; Inter + JetBrains Mono; responsive at 3 breakpoints (>1100 / 720–1100 / <720) | | `script.js` | Stat count-up via IntersectionObserver; hero block-swap micro-animation every 3.5s; full builder logic (reorder via HTML5 drag-and-drop, type switcher, add/delete, debounced auto-save status); SDK tab switcher with syntax-highlighted snippets and copy-to-clipboard toast; integrations search filter (matches name + category) with live count |

run_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Stratabox marketing site, focusing on the primary flow (pricing, product features) and adjacent interactive elements (builder, SDKs, integrations) across desktop and mobile viewports.
run_plan.summary: The run will proceed in phases: first, validate the top navigation and hero section interactions; then explore the builder and feature blocks; next, test SDK and integration sections; then check customer and pricing flows; and finally, verify mobile responsiveness and recovery paths. Each phase will exercise key interactables and check for layout issues.
assumptions: The site is a single-page app with all content in index.html
Interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) are functional and follow web standards
Layout warnings (small tap targets) are critical to validate for mobile usability
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (navigation links, builder buttons) for mobile usability
SDK tab switcher and copy functionality

phases.title: Top Navigation and Hero Section
phases.objective: Validate navigation links and hero interactables (CTAs, preview panel)
key_checks: Click navigation links (Product, Builder, SDKs, Integrations, Customers, Pricing) and verify scroll behavior
Click 'Start free' and 'Book a demo' CTAs (hero and top nav) to check interaction feedback
Observe hero preview panel (editor vs live preview) for auto-swap animation and block interactions
exit_criteria: All navigation links scroll to correct sections
CTAs show interaction feedback (e.g., hover, click states)
Hero preview animation and block structure verified

phases.title: Builder and Feature Blocks
phases.objective: Test builder interactables (drag-and-drop, add/delete blocks, type switcher) and feature cards
key_checks: Click builder buttons (+ Paragraph, + Heading, + Image, + Callout, + Quote) to add blocks
Attempt drag-and-drop reorder of builder blocks (verify visual feedback)
Test block type switcher (e.g., convert paragraph to heading)
Validate feature cards (Composable schema, Real-time collaboration, Edge content API) for interactivity
exit_criteria: Builder buttons add/remove blocks correctly
Drag-and-drop reorder works with visual feedback
Block type switcher functions as expected
Feature cards show hover/click states

phases.title: SDKs and Integrations
phases.objective: Explore SDK tab switcher, copy functionality, and integrations search
key_checks: Switch SDK tabs (JS, Python, Ruby, curl) and verify syntax highlighting/copy button
Click copy button on SDK snippets and check for toast feedback
Type in integrations search filter (e.g., 'coastal') and verify live count/results
Click 'Read the API reference' link to check navigation
exit_criteria: SDK tabs switch correctly with syntax highlighting
Copy button shows toast feedback on click
Integrations search filters results and updates count
API reference link navigates to correct section

phases.title: Customers and Pricing
phases.objective: Validate customer quotes, pricing teaser, and footer links
key_checks: Scroll to customer quotes and verify interaction (hover, click if applicable)
Click 'See full plans' CTA in pricing teaser
Check footer links (Studio, Schema, Localization, Assets, Webhooks, Docs) for scroll/navigation
Verify 'Start free' CTA in pricing section
exit_criteria: Customer quotes show interaction feedback
Pricing CTA navigates to correct section
Footer links scroll/navigate correctly
Pricing teaser content verified

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness
phases.objective: Validate layout and interactables in mobile viewport
key_checks: Switch to mobile viewport (≤720px) and recheck navigation (hamburger menu, tap targets)
Test builder and CTA interactables in mobile (small tap targets, touch feedback)
Verify hero preview, SDK tabs, and integrations search in mobile layout
Check for layout issues (small tap targets) and interaction consistency with desktop
exit_criteria: Mobile navigation (hamburger menu) functions
Key interactables (CTAs, builder buttons) are usable in mobile (tap targets ≥44px)
Layout adapts correctly (hero, SDKs, integrations)
Interaction feedback (hover, click) consistent with desktop

phases.title: Recovery and Edge Cases
phases.objective: Test error recovery (e.g., invalid search, block deletion) and edge interactions
key_checks: Enter invalid text in integrations search (e.g., 'xyz123') and verify feedback (no results, count update)
Delete all builder blocks and re-add to check recovery
Test SDK copy button with empty snippet (if applicable)
Verify footer links (e.g., 'Docs', 'Webhooks') for 404 or correct navigation
exit_criteria: Invalid search shows appropriate feedback
Builder recovers from empty state
SDK copy handles edge cases
Footer links navigate correctly

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known pages (index.html) and all sections via navigation
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible controls (buttons, links, inputs) in builder, SDKs, integrations, and pricing sections
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (navigation, builder, CTAs) in mobile viewport (≤720px)

notes: Prioritize small tap target validation in mobile phase
Verify drag-and-drop builder functionality (may require precise interactions)
Check auto-save status in builder for real-time feedback

A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. A headless content platform where editors author with composable blocks, developers query a typed GraphQL+REST API, and your team ships content to web, mobile, kiosks, and email — from a single source of truth. Start free → Book a demo ✔ 50 GB asset CDN free ✔ SOC 2 Type II ✔ EU + US regions studio.stratabox.dev / articles / coastal-bloom EDITOR ● saved H1 Coastal Bloom Returns ¶ After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… ¶ Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… ▣ hero-coast-2026.jpg · 4096×2304 ★ Callout · Tickets on sale May 22 ▦ Gallery · 8 images LIVE PREVIEW web · mobile · email Coastal Bloom Returns After a two-year hiatus the festival returns to the Pier 22 boardwalk… hero-coast-2026.jpg ★ Tickets on sale May 22 Organizers expect twelve thousand visitors over the weekend… IN PRODUCTION AT Halcyon Northwind Atlas Bicycle Vesper Wine Riverbed Pinecrest Public Radio Holm & Brock Studio Nephele 2,400+ teams shipping content 99.99% trailing-90d API uptime 42ms p50 read latency 74 locales supported out of the box Platform Built around composable blocks. Editors compose pages from typed blocks. Developers consume the same blocks through a typed API. The platform handles versioning, scheduling, localization, previews, and asset delivery. ▣ Composable schema Define content types and blocks with a visual schema editor or by committing a schema.tb file. Migrations are diffed, reviewed, and rolled back per environment. Typed references & embeds Per-field localization Backward-compatible deprecations ⟳ Real-time collaboration Multi-cursor editing on every block. Suggestions, threads, and assignment live alongside the content. Conflict-free at the field level. Per-block presence Inline review & approval Slack, Linear, Jira mirrors ⚡ Edge content API Read your content from 280 edge POPs with stale-while-revalidate. GraphQL, REST, and a typed JS/TS client are all generated from the same schema. Per-environment tokens Preview & production fork Stable webhooks & replay Studio Drag, drop, ship. Generated, typed clients for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, and Go. Plus REST and GraphQL endpoints with the same caching and webhooks.
